why_title_b: The hard part comes after, every day.
why_desc: Google Ads won't drop products that don't sell, add negative keywords or stop a campaign that spends without sales on its own. The Hontrio autopilot does it daily. Here's one week from its log.
why_text_mon: Your ads were also showing for searches like “uv nail lamp” and “h7 car bulbs”. They cost {{spend}} without a single sale, so the autopilot added them as negative keywords.
why_text_tue: The new “Outdoor lighting” campaign spent {{spend}}, one average order, without a sale. The autopilot paused it and sent you a notification.
why_text_wed: Nothing to change. The autopilot checked spend, products and searches and left everything as it was. If it isn't broken, don't fix it.
why_text_thu: A wall light spent {{spend}}, more than its price, without a sale. A set of bulbs sold once but cost more in ads than it brought in. The autopilot removed both from the campaigns.
why_text_fri: The main campaign runs out of budget every day and sells {{roas}} times what it spends. The autopilot suggests {{to}} a day instead of {{from}}, but the money is your call. Try it: approve or reject.
why_text_sat_approve: You approved. The new budget went live in your Google Ads account right away, and the change is in the log.
why_text_sat_reject: You rejected it. The budget stays at {{from}} a day, and your decision is in the log.
why_text_sun: {{n}} sales from ads in 30 days: enough for Google to bid on its own. The autopilot moved the campaign to Performance Max. All week, it asked you just one thing.
why_note: A demo store, with the autopilot in automatic mode. The screens are the app's own; the numbers are examples.
how_desc: Setup takes a few minutes. Then Hontrio works every day, and you see everything it does.
how_store_desc: Edinio in one click, WooCommerce with a read-only key, Shopify with your approval. Hontrio reads the products and the orders with their source.

how_plan_desc: Hontrio picks the products and the campaign type and checks the account. You choose how much to spend per day and launch.
how_pilot_desc: It removes what spends without selling, adds negative keywords and asks you before raising the budget. With your approval or on its own, within the limits you set.

feat_title_a: What a Google Ads specialist does.
feat_pilot_desc: Every proposal comes with its reason. Approve it, reject it, or let the autopilot apply what's safe on its own.
feat_mode_approve_desc: The autopilot proposes, you decide. On its own it only stops a campaign that spends without selling and keeps the product list in line with your catalog.
feat_mode_auto_desc: The autopilot applies changes by itself, within your limits, and sends you a notification. The budget only goes up with your approval.
feat_groups_desc: By category, brand, price range, products on sale or products you pick. Each with its own budget.
feat_rules_desc: The autopilot changes things gradually, so Google doesn't have to start learning from scratch.
feat_rule_budget: The budget only goes up with your approval, by 20% a week at most
feat_rule_learning: A new Performance Max campaign learns for 6 weeks, with no budget changes
feat_rule_loss: Spending without selling? The campaign stops by itself
feat_reports_desc: See what you spent and what the ads brought in: by day, by campaign and by product.

data_desc: We only use what we need to run your ads. We never sell your data or use it for anything else.
data_store_read: Products, prices, stock and orders, with the source of each sale.
data_store_write: Nothing in your store: we only read it. From orders we keep only what measuring the ads needs: the number, the amounts, the discount code, the country and the source, for example the ad click. We don't keep names, emails, phone numbers or addresses.
data_ads_read: Campaigns, budgets and their results: cost, conversions, conversion value and search terms.
data_ads_write: We create and adjust Hontrio's campaigns in your account. Your existing campaigns change only if you choose so at launch: we pause the ones selling the same products and add the EU political ads declaration Google requires.
data_mc_read: Product statuses, prices and how you compare with competitors.
data_mc_write: A label on the products taken out of campaigns, in a separate “Hontrio” supplemental source that we link to your product sources. We don't change the product data in your feed.
data_limited_a: Hontrio's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the
data_revoke: You can disconnect Google at any time in Settings, and access is revoked right away. The campaigns Hontrio created stay in your Google Ads account and keep running until you stop them.
faq_desc: Everything you need to know before putting your ads on autopilot.
faq_side_desc: Connect your store and see your first campaign plan in a few minutes.
faq_q1: Do I need a Google Ads account?
faq_a1: Yes. Campaigns run in your account and you pay Google directly; Hontrio only manages them. If you don't have an account, you can create one for free in a few minutes.
faq_q2: Which store platforms does it work with?
faq_a2: Edinio, WooCommerce and Shopify. Edinio connects in one click, WooCommerce with a read-only API key, and Shopify with your approval in Shopify.
faq_q3: What does Hontrio change in my Google Ads account?
faq_a3: It creates and adjusts the Hontrio campaigns: the products, the negative keywords and the budget, the latter only with your approval. Campaigns you already have are touched only if you allow it, at launch.
faq_q4: Can I control what the autopilot does?
faq_a4: Yes. In approval mode, the autopilot proposes changes and you decide. In automatic mode it applies them by itself, but the budget only goes up with your approval. In both modes, on its own it only stops a campaign that spends without selling and keeps the product list in line with your catalog. Every change stays in the log.
faq_q5: Do I need to know Google Ads?
faq_a5: No. Hontrio checks the account, builds the campaign the right way and takes care of it every day. You choose the budget and approve what the autopilot changes, and Reports show what the ads bring in.
faq_q6: I already run campaigns. Won't they clash?
faq_a6: Before launch, Hontrio audits your account: campaigns competing for the same products, the purchase conversion and the Merchant Center link. You choose what stays on.
faq_a7: From your store: products, prices, stock and orders with their source. From Google: campaigns, results and the products' status in Merchant Center. From orders we don't keep the buyer's name, email, phone number or address, and we don't sell data.
faq_a8: During the launch period, Hontrio is free. After that you pay 2% of the sales Hontrio brings you: nothing up to €1,000 a month, and €39 up to €2,000 (stores selling in lei have their own grid). You pay Google directly for the ad budget.

pricing_meta_description: You pay 2% of the sales Hontrio brings you. Free up to €1,000 a month, and €39 up to €2,000. No subscription, final prices.
pricing_desc: No subscription and no minimum term. The fee is worked out once a month, per store, only from the sales that came from Hontrio's campaigns. When sales are small, you pay a fixed amount or nothing.
pricing_steps_title: The grid, per month and per store
pricing_steps_note: What counts is the sales brought by Hontrio's campaigns in a calendar month. No cap.
pricing_vat: Final prices. We are not registered for VAT.
pricing_launch_short: Right now, during the launch period, Hontrio is free.
pricing_calc_desc: Move the slider or type the amount. The ad budget isn't part of it: you pay it directly to Google.
pricing_calc_sales: Sales brought by Hontrio in a month
pricing_calc_free: Up to {{limit}} a month, you pay nothing.
pricing_calc_flat: A fixed fee for sales of up to {{limit}} a month.
pricing_calc_launch: During the launch period you don't pay even that: Hontrio is free.

pricing_rules_desc: This is how the fee will be worked out after the launch period.
pricing_terms_link: The same rules are in the Terms, article 9.
pricing_rule1_text: Orders whose last click came from a Hontrio campaign. The store saves their source, “hontrio-…”, so you can see them in your store too.
pricing_rule2_text: The products, after discounts, without shipping and without VAT.
pricing_rule3_text: Cancelled, refused or returned orders don't count. Partial refunds are subtracted.
pricing_rule4_title: The month closes, then the invoice comes
pricing_rule4_text: The month closes on its last day. The invoice comes on the 15th of the next month, after the 14 days in which buyers can return products. A refund made after the invoice is subtracted the following month.
pricing_rule5_text: Each store has its own calculation, including its own free tier.
pricing_rule6_text: Sales in a currency other than lei or euros are converted to euros at the ECB rate of the month's last day, then the euro grid applies.
pricing_rule7_text: In Hontrio you see the list of counted orders and can contest any of them.
pricing_rule8_text: A month without sales from Hontrio costs nothing. You pay for the ads directly to Google, and that money never goes through Hontrio.
pricing_notpay_1: A subscription, a setup fee or a minimum term.
pricing_notpay_2: The ad budget: you pay it directly to Google, and it doesn't go through Hontrio.
pricing_notpay_3: Sales from other sources: unpaid Google search, other campaigns, marketplaces, your physical shop.
pricing_notpay_5: Months in which Hontrio's campaigns brought no sales.
pricing_faq_a1: No. During the launch period Hontrio is free, however much the campaigns sell. The grid applies only after we start billing, which we announce by email and in the app at least 30 days ahead. Sales made before then don't count.
pricing_faq_q2: How do you know which sales Hontrio brought?
pricing_faq_a2: Hontrio's ads bring visitors to your store with the source “hontrio-…” in the address. The store saves it on the order, and Hontrio reads it from there. Only orders whose last click came from a Hontrio campaign count, and you see the list in Hontrio.
pricing_faq_q3: Is the ad budget part of the fee?
pricing_faq_a3: No. You pay for the ads directly to Google, and Hontrio's fee is worked out only from sales, not from how much you spend on ads.
pricing_faq_q4: I have several stores. How is it worked out?
pricing_faq_a4: Separately for each store, with its own free tier. Two stores that each get €800 from Hontrio in a month pay nothing.
pricing_faq_a5: Stores selling in lei use the lei grid, and stores selling in euros use the euro grid. Sales in another currency are converted to euros at the ECB rate of the month's last day.
pricing_faq_q6: Can I stop at any time?
pricing_faq_a6: Yes. There is no subscription and no minimum term. You delete your account in Settings, and the campaigns stay in your Google Ads account and keep running until you stop them.
pricing_launch_text: Right now Hontrio is free, however much the campaigns sell. The grid on this page applies only after we start billing: we'll tell you by email and in the app at least 30 days ahead, and sales made before then don't count.
